customManagers.description: Track the uv version that setup-uv installs in CI (version: "X.Y.Z"); the github-actions manager only sees the action itself
Track tools pinned inline in workflow commands (twine==X.Y.Z, zensical==X.Y.Z)

packageRules.description: Keep action digest updates reviewable as one batch

Low-risk auto-merge: non-major updates to CI infrastructure Actions that PR CI fully exercises. Fail-closed allowlist; setup-uv and the PyPI publish Action are excluded, since the publish Action never runs in PR CI. Grouped on its own so this batch can auto-merge.
Keep uv (setup-uv's version) and the uv_build backend moving together as one build-tool change; human review
Playwright pins the reference browsers: a bump changes the Chromium the browser tests compare with, and the Firefox and WebKit reports. Human review; see MAINTENANCE.md (升級 Playwright).
Test, lint and docs tools as one reviewable batch
